verses.zh: 智慧妇人建立家室；愚妄妇人亲手拆毁。
verses.kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.en: A wise woman builds up her home, but a foolish one pulls it down with her own hands.

verses.zh: 行动正直的，敬畏耶和华；行事乖僻的，却藐视他。
verses.kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.en: Living honestly shows you respect the LORD; living crookedly shows you look down on him.

verses.zh: 愚妄人口中骄傲，如杖责打己身；智慧人的嘴必保守自己。
verses.kjv: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.en: A fool's proud talk is a stick on his own back, but wise lips keep a person safe.

verses.zh: 家里无牛，槽头干净；土产加多乃凭牛力。
verses.kjv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.en: With no ox the feeding trough stays clean, but it takes an ox's strength to bring in a big harvest.

verses.zh: 诚实见证人不说谎话；假见证人吐出谎言。
verses.kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.en: A truthful witness does not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

verses.zh: 亵慢人寻智慧，却寻不着；聪明人易得知识。
verses.kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
verses.en: Someone who sneers looks for wisdom and never finds it, but knowledge comes easily to a person who understands.

verses.zh: 到愚昧人面前，不见他嘴中有知识。
verses.kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
verses.en: Walk away from a foolish person; you will find no knowledge on his lips.

verses.zh: 通达人的智慧在乎明白己道；愚昧人的愚妄乃是诡诈。
verses.kjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.en: A sensible person's wisdom is understanding their own way; a fool's foolishness is fooling themselves.

verses.zh: 愚妄人犯罪，以为戏耍；正直人互相喜悦。
verses.kjv: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
verses.en: Fools laugh at doing wrong, but good people treat each other kindly.

verses.zh: 心中的苦楚，自己知道；心里的喜乐，外人无干。
verses.kjv: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
verses.en: Your heart knows its own sadness, and a stranger cannot share its joy.

verses.zh: 奸恶人的房屋必倾倒；正直人的帐棚必兴盛。
verses.kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.en: The house of bad people will be knocked down, but the tent of honest people will do well.

verses.zh: 有一条路，人以为正，至终成为死亡之路。
verses.kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.en: There is a road that looks right to a person, but in the end it leads to death.

verses.zh: 人在喜笑中，心也忧愁；快乐至极就生愁苦。
verses.kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
verses.en: Even while laughing the heart can ache, and that happiness can end in sadness.

verses.zh: 心中背道的，必满得自己的结果；善人必从自己的行为得以知足。
verses.kjv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
verses.en: A person whose heart turns away gets filled with their own ways, but a good person is satisfied with theirs.

verses.zh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。
verses.kjv: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
verses.en: A simple person believes anything, but a sensible person watches every step.

verses.zh: 智慧人惧怕，就远离恶事；愚妄人却狂傲自恃。
verses.kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.en: A wise person is careful and stays away from wrong, but a fool rages and is sure of himself.

verses.zh: 轻易发怒的，行事愚妄；设立诡计的，被人恨恶。
verses.kjv: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.en: Getting angry quickly makes a person act foolishly, and someone full of sly plans is hated.

verses.zh: 愚蒙人得愚昧为产业；通达人得知识为冠冕。
verses.kjv: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.en: Simple people end up with foolishness, but sensible people are crowned with knowledge.

verses.zh: 坏人俯伏在善人面前；恶人俯伏在义人门口。
verses.kjv: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.en: Bad people will bow down before good people, and the wicked at the gate of those who do right.

verses.zh: 贫穷人连邻舍也恨他；富足人朋友最多。
verses.kjv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
verses.en: A poor person is disliked even by their neighbour, but a rich person has many friends.

verses.zh: 藐视邻舍的，这人有罪；怜悯贫穷的，这人有福。
verses.kjv: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
verses.en: Looking down on your neighbour is doing wrong, but being kind to poor people brings happiness.

verses.zh: 谋恶的，岂非走入迷途吗？谋善的，必得慈爱和诚实。
verses.kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
verses.en: Do those who plan evil not go astray? But those who plan good find kindness and honesty.

verses.zh: 诸般勤劳都有益处；嘴上多言乃致穷乏。
verses.kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
verses.en: All hard work brings something in, but talk alone leads to being poor.

verses.zh: 智慧人的财为自己的冠冕；愚妄人的愚昧终是愚昧。
verses.kjv: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
verses.en: Wise people's riches are their crown, but the foolishness of fools stays foolishness.

verses.zh: 作真见证的，救人性命；吐出谎言的，施行诡诈。
verses.kjv: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
verses.en: A truthful witness saves lives, but someone who pours out lies is playing tricks.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华的，大有倚靠；他的儿女也有避难所。
verses.kjv: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.en: Respecting the LORD makes a person strong and sure, and gives their children a safe place.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华就是生命的泉源，可以使人离开死亡的网罗。
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.en: Respecting the LORD is a fountain of life that turns you away from deadly traps.

verses.zh: 帝王荣耀在乎民多；君王衰败在乎民少。
verses.kjv: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.en: A king's glory is having many people; a ruler is ruined when there are few.

verses.zh: 不轻易发怒的，大有聪明；性情暴躁的，大显愚妄。
verses.kjv: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.en: Being slow to get angry shows real understanding; a quick temper shows great foolishness.

verses.zh: 心中安静是肉体的生命；嫉妒是骨中的朽烂。
verses.kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.en: A peaceful heart gives the body life, but jealousy rots the bones.

verses.zh: 欺压贫寒的，是辱没造他的主；怜悯穷乏的，乃是尊敬主。
verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
verses.en: Bullying a poor person insults the God who made them, but being kind to the needy honours him.

verses.zh: 恶人在所行的恶上必被推倒；义人临死，有所投靠。
verses.kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
verses.en: Bad people are knocked down by their own wrongdoing, but a good person has somewhere to turn even in death.

verses.zh: 智慧存在聪明人心中；愚昧人心里所存的，显而易见。
verses.kjv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.en: Wisdom rests in the heart of a person who understands, but what is in a fool's heart shows plainly.

verses.zh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。
verses.kjv: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.en: Doing right lifts a nation up, but doing wrong brings shame on a people.

verses.zh: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠；贻羞的仆人遭其震怒。
verses.kjv: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
verses.en: A king is pleased with a wise servant, but angry with one who brings shame.
